checks.name: Atomic metadata/digest publication
checks.evidence: scripts/inquiry-evaluate.py:46-62,257-264 publishes one run.json containing both metadata and its digest. write_atomic creates the temporary file in the destination directory, writes and flushes it, fsyncs it, then performs one os.replace. No second authoritative sidecar write remains. Before replacement, publication failure preserves the previous checkpoint; after replacement, the new checkpoint already contains its corresponding digest. This reasoning concerns metadata publication and process interruption, not power-loss durability.
